name: First Sensor AG
summary: First Sensor AG engages in the development, production, and sale of sensor chips, sensor components, sensors, and sensor systems in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Rest of Europe, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company offers antennas, application tooling, cable assemblies, connectors, energy and power, fiber optics, heat shrink tubing, identification and labeling, relays, contactors, sensors, switches, terminals and splices, wire and cable, EMI and EMC solutions, application tooling, fiber optics, medical device components, relays and contactors, wire protection and management accessories, heat shrink tubing, identification and labelling, and passive components.
